PSSF.description: Plate Stiffness Scale Factor (PSSF). Keyed by element number; the ITEMS array holds one scale-factor set per boundary group, each entry identified by its serial ID and optional boundary GROUP_NAME.

ITEMS.description: List of plate stiffness scale-factor entries for this element key. Each entry is matched to an existing record by ID, or by GROUP_NAME when the ID does not yet exist.

ID.description: Serial number of the scale-factor entry within this element key.

GROUP_NAME.description: Name of an existing Boundary Group. Must reference a boundary group that already exists; a non-empty name that is not found is rejected. Empty string means no boundary group.

SHEAR.description: In-plane shear stiffness scale factor Fxy.

OUT_BENDING_X.description: Out-of-plane bending stiffness scale factor Mxx.

OUT_BENDING_Y.description: Out-of-plane bending stiffness scale factor Myy.

OUT_TORSION.description: Out-of-plane torsional bending stiffness scale factor Mxy.

OUT_SHEAR_X.description: Out-of-plane shear stiffness scale factor Vxx.

OUT_SHEAR_Y.description: Out-of-plane shear stiffness scale factor Vyy.
